headline: Shell’s profits more than double after jump in oil and gas prices
context: Environmentalists renew calls for windfall tax to support households after Q2 earnings rise to almost $10bn Shell has posted its second highest quarterly earnings on record as the energy market surge caused by the Middle East crisis helped to double its net profit to almost $10bn

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Environmentalists renew calls for windfall tax to support households after Q2 earnings rise to almost $10bn Shell has posted its second highest quarterly earnings on record as the energy market surge caused by the Middle East crisis helped to double its net profit to almost $10bn in the three months to June. Europe’s biggest oil and gas company reported a quarterly profit of $9.8bn (£7.4bn), more than double the figure for the second quarter last year and the highest since its record-high earnings in the months after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
